_comment: Layout, sizing and typography for text-field. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here. Placeholder and input text share one Figma role (body/md/regular) and differ only in colour, so they share `typography-input-*`.

base._source: clear-icon-size is storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — design.md's iconography.sizes are still 'tbd', so the 16px from the Figma icons-size instance stays a literal.

_verified_from.scope: all 8 variants, plus a depth-3 walk of State=Default
_verified_from.result: No discrepancies. Field 42 tall, radius 8, padding 10/16, gap 8; stack gap 4; label inset 4. Border 1px except State=Active at 2px. Label 14/22 Medium = title.md.medium; the required marker 12/18 Medium = label.md.medium; input and placeholder 14/22 Regular = body.md.regular; error 10/16 Regular = caption.md.regular; clear icon 16.
_verified_from.noted: Each variant carries a hidden `Filled/Old/Check-circle` instance — a legacy leftover of the same kind that made the Checkbox build wrong twice. It is hidden and unused here, which is correct.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. check-figma-icons.py holds the files in `sources` to exactly this set — an extra icon fails as loudly as a missing one, because an extra is one nobody compared. Files not listed in `sources` carry payload a caller passes, not a choice the design makes.

icons.filled-close: the clear affordance inside `Field`. Hidden on every variant — Figma ships it off, so it only appears once a value is typed. Recorded because the source must be able to draw it, not because a variant shows it.
